data.rationale: The adopted dispatcher asks QuickBooks for minor version 70. Intuit retired minor versions 1-74 on 2025-08-01: a request below 75 is ignored and answered as 75. Every journal entry is therefore already created under version 75 while the code declares 70, so the code no longer describes what runs, and the behaviour depends on Intuit continuing to ignore the retired value instead of rejecting it. — proposed by maintenance: maintenance event 8319f21e-406d-4db8-8d46-c0e224187279
